name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Adopt the **Claude Self-Improvement Skill Pack** to automate prompt tuning and routing. It’s the fastest path to measurable gains because it replaces manual tweaks with a proven system—no new infrastructure, just plug-and-play skills that iterate on prompts in real time. The trade-off is dependency on the Skill Pack’s quality; if it underperforms, we lose control over the tuning process.

name: Gauge
text: The Skill Pack’s "automated prompt tuning" is a black box—we’d trade drift risk for speed. A 24-hour canary to 5% still risks 1 in 20 users hitting a broken prompt. The safer alternative is manual prompt reviews with a rollback plan; settle it by running a controlled A/B test comparing Skill Pack output to human-tuned prompts over two weeks.
